name: Sill Line, Wired
tagline: The family's week is a lit wire: the tube drops it onto stop one, every plan stands on the sill in one grammar, and the lists below hang from short tracks of their own.
concept: The board still stands on its sill, lit only from now to stop one. Every plan is one kind of thing: a plate on a steel post over its ring stop, with its top level with plate one's glass. The Next up tube is plate one in glass, and its power lamp drops the lit wire onto the rail. Below the sill every list hangs from one kind of short track: a rail in the gutter, a ring on the rule head's line, a T under the last row, and one lamp. It feels like a calm signal box at night, lit only on the wire that matters.
companions: Steel #56708c draws the rails, the plates' posts, the ring stops, the tick squares and the T buffers. Ink plates (#1a2230) carry a bone cap (#cfc6b0 at 70%) in place of the navy one, on Home's plates, the month's events, the Plans list's rows (as a left cap) and the family's chat lines. Each kind's grounded colour is drawn as its icon in a 20px ring on every plate: trip and day trip cyan #70dcf4, show pink #ff9fd0, outing moss #b5c87d, activity lemon, restaurant amber. On the month it is a solid 8px kind dot, and on Lately added it is the ring and the word. Amber is kept for late words, the setup strip's edge and current ring, 'needs a look' and the foot lamp's trouble state. Sage marks 'now' and done. The bright #6dff9c stays on the mark, Send and the primaries, 'plan', the box's glass edge and '›' prompt, the status line's figures and cursor, the now lamps, the lit run and wire to stop one (Home, the month, the Plans list), the tube, To do's now line, Lately's newest lamp, the foot's Ready lamp and focus.
decisions: Started from x14a-sill-cross. The new rules are in src/wired.css, appended last. Superseded rules were deleted from the older sources rather than overridden: the parent's plans-list plate rules, the duplicated To do head rules and the faceplate column split. build.py now also drops any base declaration that a later rule with the same selector and @media sets again. That freed about 6 KB, so the sheet is 196 KB of the 200 KB limit with the new rules in it.

One grammar for every plan, on Home's plates, Home's phone rows, the tube and the Plans list. The order is: the kind's icon in a 20px ring of its colour, the name (Archivo 75% 600, 1.125rem, balanced, Mount St. Helens unbroken), 'for Maya' in dim, then the day numeral (DM Mono 1.5rem, month over weekday in label caps) beside the time (DM Mono, body size) over 'in 7 days'. The whole plate is the link, with a 2px phosphor focus ring, and hover lifts it to surface-3 with a bone cap.

The plates stand on posts. Their tops are level with plate one's bezel, and a 1px steel post runs from under each plate's ring to its ring stop. The tube's extra height becomes posts, not empty graphite. This follows the 14a lesson: shrink or add, never stretch.

The tube is plate one, in VT323. It has the NEXT UP tag, the kind's icon in a phosphor ring with the name, 'for Maya, Theo' at 82% dim phosphor, then the numeral beside 13:00 over [IN 2 DAYS] with the cursor. The 64px corner graticule lets it narrow to 21rem. Its power lamp drops a 2px lit wire onto stop one's lit ring. The run from the breathing white-hot now lamp to stop one is the only lit run, with the kit's 6px/18px bloom and airglow masked to it.

The box is glass lit from beneath, with an inset bottom-weighted glow and a 1px faded top highlight. A lit DM Mono '›' leads the placeholder. Folio's status line sits on the glass ('4 plans · 3 late · Vera is listening'): its words are now steel-grey dim, and only the figures and the 1.06s block cursor are lit.

One rule for every short track: the rail in the section's gutter, a 10px ring where it meets the rule head's line, the head set 3rem in, rows hung to the right, a T under the last row, and one lamp. Things that are stops sit on the rail as rings (Lately's ideas, the kids' wishes behind a pink gift ring). To do's square ticks are controls in their own column, clear of the rail. To do's lamp is its now line, which leaves the rail at a breathing lit dot with 'now' set on the line. /tasks uses the same track, with its panel dropped.
Column heads are sentence case, 12px Archivo 600 in label ink, on one baseline: Day, Done (centred over the ticks, 16px clear of Day), Thing to do, Who, Due, and Edit on the page.

The foot on every page is the machine's status on a 3.5rem stub of rail: a breathing Ready lamp, 'Ready · OpenAI gpt-6-luna · $0.00 of $2.00 today' with DM Mono figures, and 'Status →'. The lamp key appears only where lamps are drawn.

Plans. The month's events now carry their kind (an 8px dot in its colour; Nutcracker is pink and Oaks Park lemon). The NOW run ends in Home's lit ring: phosphor edge, 6px/18px bloom and a white-hot core. The List view is rebuilt in the plate grammar and unboxed: day numeral in the margin, ring on the rail (the first one lit at the end of the now run), then an ink plate with a bone left cap holding the kind ring, the name, and the time over how far off.

Phone. The order is the title, the box (one growing line, no resize grip, no status line under 30rem), the starters (shrink-wrapped 44px keys in one snap-scrolling row with a fade), then the sill down the gutter. A bug left the phone's lit run spanning the whole rail with no visible wire: an absolutely placed grid item resolves an auto end line to the container's edge. It is fixed with explicit 3 / 4 rows, so the run is lit only to stop one, where the tube's wire meets it. The whole tube is on the first 844px screen.

Status. The meter pane is a fixed 23rem, so the dial is shorter and the lamp board lost most of its dead glass. The duplicate 'Average day' readout is gone, so the average is said once, at the ghost needle's tip, outside the arc. The tallies sit under a 'Today' rule. The lists below are unboxed, and only the alert keeps a box. Settings' card list is unboxed between two rules.

Palette: the token plate-cap is #99958a and the sheet draws the cap as bone at 70%, with #cfc6b0 for hover. topGlow is 0.35. Send's resting halo, the box's outer halo and the NEXT UP tag's glow are drawn close, while hover and fills keep the light.
title: What needs a *plan*? Tell Vera. 'What needs a plan?' is the display line at 3rem in Archivo condensed, with 'plan' lit (two-layer halo plus a white-hot core) and the '?' in ink. 'Tell Vera.' sits on its baseline at 1.5rem in ink-2 as the box's spoken label, and drops under the line on the phone. It says FamilyDB's job: anything that needs arranging (a weekend, a reminder, an idea, a wish) is handed to Vera here. The lit word sits over the lit run of plans that answers it.
measures: Full render: 0 hard checks failed. One guideline missed, the page's words: Home differs from today's by 34.2%, from the title's 'Tell Vera.', the placeholder, the status line, 'Done', the foot. ink_on_bg 12.75, brand_on_bg 15.18. Home's green share is 60.5% of coloured pixels, down from 63%; it was 61.4% after the first pass. Hue entropy on Home is 0.503. Other pages: ideas 57.6% green, chat 57.8%, status 64.5%. Home has 57 targets, 1 under 44px and 0 under 24px. Smallest text 12px, no sideways scroll, every colour-distance check passes. The sheet is 196,129 of 200,000 characters.
strengths: Every plan in the app is drawn in one grammar: Home's plates, the phone rows, the Plans list and the tube share one order (kind ring, name, whom it is for, day numeral, time over how far off). The tube reads as the lit first plate, not a second drawing.

The light is wired to what it reports. One lit run goes from now to stop one, a wire drops from the tube's power lamp onto it, the month and the Plans list end their now runs in the same lit ring, and each list below the sill has exactly one lamp.
One rule for lists without time holds on Home, To do, Status and Settings: unboxed under a rule head, hung from a short track (gutter rail, ring at the head, T under the last row).
The plates on posts fix the row without stretching. Their tops line up with plate one's glass, and the difference in height becomes steel posts that make the stops read as stops.
On the phone, the title, the box, the starters and the whole of plate one with its wire fit on the first screen.
The type is one system: sentence-case column heads on one baseline, Day and Done clear of each other, DM Mono wherever a time or a sum is read, times at body size, and balanced plate names.
weaknesses: Home is at 60.5% green, a hair over the 60% aimed at. The mark, Send, 'plan', the tube and the lit run carry it, and the brief asked to keep all of those.
The ink plates are shorter than plate one, so their posts run about 70px. It reads as signs on posts, but a judge may want fuller plates.

Several values are still worked out in templates by reading the database: the kinds and people on Home's plates, the kinds on the month and on the Plans list, the status line's counts, the foot's spend, and To do's absolute dates. Each should be a field from views.py.
Lately's lamp, a 4px point in the newest ring, is small at 100% and may be missed at a glance.
On the phone, 'Send where I am' still takes a second row in the box, and the starters row shows one key and part of the next; the fade is the only cue that it scrolls.
The two panes of the Status faceplate end at different heights, because 'Change the limit' sits under the meter's glass.
About a third of Home's words differ from today's.
revisions: To do head: the rail no longer runs through 'Done'. Every short track now shares one geometry: rail in the section's gutter (1.2rem), ring on the rule head's line, head set 3rem in, T under the last row. To do's ticks moved into their own column clear of the rail. Day and Done sit on one baseline, 16px apart. The now line leaves the rail at a breathing lit dot with 'now' set on the line. The kids' wishes are the last stop, a gift ring on the rail.
/tasks uses the same track. The tray/panel is dropped (class track-list), with a ring at the column heads, the rail running through 'Renew library cards' and the footnote, and a T buffer at the end.

Kind rings: instead of hollow 14px rings (which read as radios), every plate shows its kind's icon in a 20px ring of the kind's colour, as Lately added does, and the tube's ring carries its icon in phosphor. The month's events now receive their kind (passed into the event macro) and show a solid 8px kind dot. Nutcracker is show-pink and Oaks Park has its lemon dot.

Plate rows: the plates no longer stretch. Their tops are level with plate one's bezel, and a 1px steel post drops from each ring to its stop. The foot of each plate is a fixed block (day numeral beside the time over the relative), so no plate wraps raggedly. The tube puts [IN 2 DAYS] under 13:00 in the same block and narrowed to 21rem. I set the relative under the time rather than beside it: at 200px of plate, '24 OCT SAT 08:00 in 3 weeks' wraps unevenly, and the stacked block matches the phone rows.

Plans: the month's NOW run now ends in the same lit ring as Home's stop one. The List view is rebuilt in the plate grammar and unboxed: day numeral in the margin, ring on the rail with the first one lit, and an ink plate with a bone left cap holding the kind ring, the name, and the time over the relative. It is not in the judges' shots; I checked it in my own render.

Phone: fixed a real bug, where abs-positioned grid items with grid-row: 3 resolved their end to the container edge. The lit run had been spanning the whole rail and the wire had been invisible; now the run stops at stop one and the wire meets the tube's power lamp. The Calendar note moved below the rail. The textarea is one line with no resize grip. The status line is hidden under 30rem. The starter keys are shrink-wrapped at .875rem. The whole tube now sits on the first screen.

Colour: the glass status line's words are dim steel-grey, with only the figures and the cursor lit. The tube's 'for Maya, Theo' is phosphor-dim at 82%; 70% would have fallen below 4.5:1 on the glass, so I kept 82%. The NEXT UP tag's glow is drawn close. Home went from 63% to 60.5% green. The lit run, the wire and 'plan' were not cut.

Status: the meter pane is fixed at 23rem, so the faceplate's panes balance and the lamp board has much less dead glass. The duplicate 'Average day $0.04' readout is removed, leaving only the label at the ghost needle's tip. The lists below are unboxed, and only the alert keeps its box. Settings' card list is unboxed between two rules.

Size: build.py's dedupe now runs over the base and the series sheet together, and a same-property fallback inside one rule is no longer dropped. Superseded rules were deleted from sill.css and cross.css, so the sheet is 196 KB with the new rules.

Declined, in part: 'Send where I am' on the phone's From row. At 390px the select, the mic and Send already fill the row (about 283px), and making Send icon-only would weaken the signature button, so it stays on a compact second row. Also declined: hiding the status line 'under 24rem' as the brief wrote it. The phone is 24.4rem wide, so I hid it under 30rem, which does what was meant.
crit: HOME, the To do head: the track's 2px steel rail (x≈188) runs straight through the 'Done' column head, and 'Day' and 'Done' are jammed together. In the shot it reads 'Day Done' with the rail striking through the D. Start the rail at the first row's tick rather than at the rule head ring, or give the rail column its own head cell and set 'Done' clear of it, with at least 12px between 'Day' and 'Done'. Then put the head ring at the rail's top beside the 'To do' rule, as Lately added does.

HOME, the two short tracks are not one geometry. Lately added's rail sits at the section's left edge, with its head ring above the 'Lately added' head and the rows to its right. To do's rail sits inside the table, between the Day column and the title, and its ring sits on the rule. Pick one rule for every short track (rail at the section's left gutter, ring on the rule head's line, T buffer under the last row) and apply it to both. On /tasks, the rail stops dead at the 'now' line with no head ring and no T buffer, and the list still sits in a .panel box. Carry the same track on /tasks: ring at the head, the rail running through 'Renew library cards' to a T, and the panel background, border and radius dropped as on Home.

HOME, the plates' kind rings: 14px hollow rings with their icons hidden (wired.css:89 `:is(.sill-plate, .next-title) .kind-ring .icon { display: none; }`) read as unchecked radio buttons. That is next to To do's square ticks, and the tube's phosphor ring reads as a radio too. A newcomer has no way to read the kind. Either keep the icon in a 20px ring as the parent did, or fill the ring's centre with a 5px dot of its kind hue (#70dcf4, #ff9fd0, #b5c87d, #ffb850), so it reads as a lamp in the kind's colour rather than a control. The month's event rings on Plans need the same treatment. There, Oaks Park's plate has no ring at all, and Nutcracker's looks cyan, not show-pink: check that the kind class reaches .month events.

HOME, the plate rows: the brief asked for one line of time and relative ('09:00 · in 7 days'). The plates set 'in 7 days' on a third line under the day numeral, which makes every plate 130px and leaves the tube's top 70px above the plates' tops. Put the relative on the time's line, trim the plate's bottom padding, and top-align the plates to the tube's glass (align-items: end on the row is fine, but let the plate rows grow to the tube's height with the name at the top), so the four plates read as one row of stops.

PLANS: the brief's grammar is not carried through. The NOW run on the month ends in a hollow steel-cyan ring on the 4th, but the brief and Home both end the lit run in a LIT ring. Make the month's terminal ring the same lit ring as Home's stop one: phosphor edge, 6px/18px bloom, white-hot core. The List view was not reworked into the phone-row plate grammar (ring, name, time and relative, with the day numeral at the left, on one steel rail). Do it, because Plans is a page this standard must hold on.

HOME PHONE: stop one's tube does not show on the first 844px screen. Its body is cut by the tab bar under the title. The box takes about 190px because 'Send where I am' wraps to its own row and the textarea keeps a tall empty area with a resize grip. Put the checkbox and the label on the From row, or fold it into the mic key's row with the select narrowed. Keep the textarea at rows=1 and remove its resize grip, and hide the status line under 24rem as the brief said (it is still shown). The starters' scroll row shows only one key and four letters of the next. Make each key shrink-wrap its words (the first is 530px wide) so two show before the fade.

COLOUR: Home measures 63% green against the 60% aimed at. The glass status line is set in --phosphor-dim throughout. Set its words in --dim steel-grey and keep only the two figures and the cursor bright. Dim the tube's 'for Maya, Theo' line to --phosphor-dim at 70%. Do not cut the lit run, the wire or 'plan'. The green belongs there.

STATUS: the lamp board has about 90px of dead glass above and below its three rows. Centre the rows less loosely (or shorten the glass to the meter's height) so the faceplate's two panes balance. 'avg $0.04' is now said twice, as the arc label and as '— AVERAGE DAY $0.04' at the top right. Keep only the one at the ghost needle's tip. 'Who answers' and the lists below still sit in .panel boxes with an inner rule head. Under the line's own rule ('lists without time sit unboxed under a rule head'), drop the box as on Home. The same applies to Settings' card list.

firstDraft.name: Sill Line, Wired
firstDraft.concept: The board still stands on its sill, lit only from now to stop one. Every plan on it is now one kind of thing: a plate on a leg over its ring stop. The Next up tube is plate one, in glass, and its power lamp drops the lit wire onto the rail. Above the sill the box is lit glass carrying a line of the machine's own. Below it, To do and Lately added hang unboxed from short tracks with one lamp each, and every page ends on the machine's status, set on a stub of the same rail: a calm signal box at night, lit only on the wire that matters.
